subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: After the SDK surface budgets pass, should OpenClaw accept the MXC 0.7.0 preview native dependency and its full base64 config envelope on the wxc-exec argv for this official plugin?
rationale: The upstream contract exposes sandbox policy and process configuration through argv and executes packaged native binaries; automated review cannot determine the repository's acceptable security posture.

options.title: Wait for non-argv transport
options.body: Pause the PR until microsoft/mxc#626 provides an acceptable transport, then refresh the implementation and exact-head Windows proof.

options.title: Accept preview boundary
options.body: Approve the final exact-head dependency graph and ship the plugin with the documented prerelease and argv exposure limitation.

recommendation.title: Wait for non-argv transport
recommendation.body: Pause the PR until microsoft/mxc#626 provides an acceptable transport, then refresh the implementation and exact-head Windows proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the current substantive sandbox and security review and explicitly identified this remaining decision.
